title: Post paid invoices in Slack
summary: When an invoice is paid in full, post its number and amount in a Slack channel.
description: Whenever one of your invoices is paid in full, posts its number and amount in the Slack channel you choose, so whoever ships or delivers knows at once. The customer's own receipt is a separate template.

params.name: slack_connection
params.title: Slack connection
params.description: Your Slack workspace, connected with Add to Slack.

params.name: channel
params.title: Slack channel
params.description: Where the message is posted. For a private channel, invite the Taskiem app to it first.

input.text: ='Invoice ' + trigger.body.number + ' (' + trigger.body.amount + ') is paid in full.'
